svg.text: D3PM Token Matrix Diffusion: Multi-Resolution Behavioral Denoising
Discrete diffusion over tokenizations at multiple truncation points of operator rollouts
Tokenize rollout[:t] at each truncation point ➡ 90 tokens each
~360 discrete token indices (4 truncations x 30 groups x 3 levels)
Uniform categorical noise: Qt = (1 - betat) * I + betat * (1/V)
Cosine schedule, 50 steps | Each token independently corrupted
Per-codebook vocab sizes: L0 ~28, L1 ~12, L2 ~6
~360 corrupted token indices at diffusion step t
Determines which tokens are targets (predicted) vs observed (conditioned on)
Pre-LN bidirectional encoder | 6 layers, 8 heads, d=256
Per-codebook Embedding(Vk, 256) + Positional Emb + Truncation-Level Emb + Timestep MLP(t)
[B, ~360, 256] -- each token position gets codebook-specific + structural embeddings
Hierarchical L0 Guidance: avg(L0 embeddings) ➡ project ➡ add as 0.1x residual
~360 independent Linear(256, Vk) ➡ logits p(x0 | xt, t) per token position
Per-codebook cross-entropy on target (masked) positions only
SNR weighting: 1/betat (emphasize low-noise steps) | Vocab weighting: log(Vk)/log(Vmax)
Optional: physics-aware auxiliary loss (soft-decode logits through frozen VQ inverse heads)
At each reverse step: re-noise observed tokens to t-1 via forward process, substitute back in
Condition on: observed token subset (e.g., t=32 row, or L0 codes, or specific groups)
Generate: remaining tokens consistent with observed conditioning
~360 clean token indices -- complete multi-resolution behavioral specification
Token matrix: 4 truncations x 30 groups x 3 levels = ~360 tokens | hidden_dim=256 | t_diffusion=50
Codebook vocab: L0 ~28, L1 ~12, L2 ~6 | Combinatorial space: ~10^360 (sparse occupancy)
Learns how behavioral representations resolve over time: early truncations constrain but do not determine later ones
Temporal causal masking harnesses the causal structure latent in token grounding as inductive bias
